title: mut.feedback
mutation_directive: Expand from a single audio-particle field into MEANINGFULLY-COMPOSED CURLY-LEAVES WORLD. Build 5-12 distinct curly-leaf elements at varying scale (some intimate close-up, some distant), each leaf rendered as a SHEET (ParametricGeometry / curved Plane with bezier midrib), with calligraphic edge curl. ARRANGE them as if composing a small terrarium / a garden vignette / a coral grove / a library of unfurling pages. Add depth-stratification so closer leaves are larger + warmer-lit, distant leaves smaller + cooler. The audio reactivity drives subtle leaf-edge breathing, NOT general jitter. World-feel: someone has CURATED these leaves; they belong together. MOTION-VARIETY HARD RULE (user 2026-05-07): pieces like td1 currently OVER-USE rotation. Iterations of td1 must use a NON-ROTATIONAL motion law from the 10-word vocabulary in scripts/motion_graph.json — pick from drift / pulse / cascade / murmur / ascend / shatter / trace / breathe / propagate. Pure rotation (or 'spinning around an axis') is BANNED for td1 descendants until other motion words have been explored.

threejs_review.directive: Replace CPU-built fern pinnae with GPU instanced quads (InstancedMesh) for each pinna, using a custom vertex shader to curve them. This unlocks 10× more pinnae per frond without framerate loss, enabling lush high-density foliage.
